items.headline: Biotech Startup Uses Bacteria to Dye Silk in Lab
items.blurb: Engineered bacteria could replace toxic chemical dyeing, reducing fashion's environmental footprint while opening new design possibilities.

items.headline: Vintage Denim Becomes Go-To Base for Classic Horror Costume Design
items.blurb: Shows how archival denim can inspire seasonal product lines and expand usage occasions beyond everyday wear.

items.headline: Fashion-Enter and Source Fashion expand UK manufacturing initiative
items.blurb: Designers gain access to expanded domestic production capacity and local supply chain partnerships across Britain's fashion regions.

items.headline: Brands Navigate ACOTAR Licensing Without Official Design Guidelines
items.blurb: Designers must interpret literary IP independently, balancing creative freedom with brand consistency and fan expectations.

items.headline: Victoria Beckham Returns to Gap for Fall Collection
items.blurb: Collaboration signals continued demand for celebrity-designer partnerships and heritage denim silhouettes in seasonal collections.
